doc.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Coltrane and North Carolina roots
summary: He knew Coltrane from North Carolina and says his long practicing was drug-related.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: Did you get to know Coltrane?
Yeah, I knew him. Coltrane’s from North Carolina.
I was going to ask you about that. Monk as well had roots in North Carolina.
Yes, Monk’s from Wilson, North Carolina. I knew Coltrane real well. He was a
hard-working guy. But most of his stuff was drug-related.
He’d get high, go in a room and play eight hours, you know, without coming out. Drugs. They don’t tell people that when they’re talking about him.
